deploy-bot: [PROMOTE] prom-2026-05-12-11 -> FAILED at step 'artifact-verify' (artifact=service-worker/4.0.1.tgz)

nora: Staging smoke shows tar failure: tar: Unexpected EOF. Verify shows content-length smaller than expected.

kai: paste verify output?

deploy-bot: ```
VERIFY: service-worker/4.0.1.tgz
expected_size=5242880
fetched_size=1024
server=object-store-eu-west
result=TRUNCATED_OBJECT
```

devops-reeva: That looks like a multipart overwrite edge case. We had a runner restart that retried the multipart upload with part 0-size, and the final CompleteMultipartUpload accepted the incomplete parts list.

nora: ugh. Immediate actions: HOLD promotion, set console pin to v4.0.0, and block auto-retry until we recover.

deploy-bot: [ACTION] prom-2026-05-12-11 status=HOLD (auto-retry disabled)

kai: I'll fetch the original artifact from the build-cache on worker-442 and reupload manually. Also taking a copy to the retention bucket.

ci-bot: note: packager pipeline build-442 logged "multipart retry: part-size=0, marking part as placeholder" at 2026-05-12T11:02:13Z.

devops-reeva: good catch. After recovery we should add a pre-complete validation: total_content_length >= sum(parts). If mismatch, abort and alert.

nora: agree. Also add a short release note: "Promotion paused: artifact truncated in object store due to multipart retry anomaly; manual recovery and checksum verification applied."

kai: recovery done. origin_sha256=1a2b3c4d...; uploaded object size=5242940, sha256 matches. rerunning verification...

deploy-bot: [PROMOTE] re-run verification -> OK. Waiting for human approval.

release-czar: Approving now. Please also create a small incremental change to the packager: fail build if any uploaded part size==0 and send alert to #eng-releases. We'll plan full uploader hardening in next sprint.

devops-reeva: I'll open a follow-up ticket and schedule a quick hotfix during tomorrow's change window (2026-05-13 08:00 PT) to add the pre-complete validation.

ci-bot: temporary guard added: pipeline will fail if any part_size == 0. rollout id=guard-0512.

nora: promo resumed and completed at 2026-05-12T11:05:00Z. closing hold.

release-czar: Thanks. I'll update release notes and keep the postmortem on calendar to review uploader behavior and runner retries. :thumbsup:
